title: GetResourceDamage - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script Returns the total amount of damage on either the given resource actor value, or all resource actor values on this object. Syntax: float Function GetResourceDamage(ActorValue akValue = None) native Parameters: - akValue: If specified, a Resource-type Actor Value. Default: None Return Value: The amount of damage for the specified actor value, or the sum of all damaged resource actor values. Examples: ; How much damage has been done to MyMutFruit's Food resource? float foodDamage = MyMutFruit.GetResourceDamage(Food)
; What's the total amount of damage done to all resources on SanctuaryWorkshopRef? float allDamage = SanctuaryWorkshopRef.GetResourceDamage() See Also: - ObjectReference Script - Game Script
